HIMALAYAN HEMP ECO STAY

The luxury of
being here.

Morning light on lime walls. Mountain air through wooden windows. The rare pleasure of a day with nowhere else to be.

Welcome to an ancestral hemp home in Uttarakhand. Stay within the material, meet the ideas behind the walls, and discover a slower rhythm rooted in village life.

FROM PLANT TO PLACE

A home today.
A living showcase
taking shape.

Our ancestral property brings hemp-based architecture and Himalayan village life together. We are developing an integrated hemp farm and immersive living experience around the home.
